note: Theorem -> 01e property mapping for the ethereum-vuln-dataset track (M2 Track C / c-1, speca#146), the third target of this plugin alongside gasper-lean4's theorem_map.json and EthTotal's theorem_map_ethtotal.json. The 66 entries formalize, one entry = one theorem, every severity Critical/High entry of NyxFoundation/ethereum-vuln-dataset at ethvuln_ref: the invariant each bug broke, stated as a Lean 4 proposition. The Lean sources live IN THIS REPO under lean/SpecaExport/EthVuln/ (so `source`/`ref` name this plugin, and each x_layer / lean_artifact path is relative to lean/); the fully-qualified theorem is EthVulnFormalProps.entry_<sanitized id>_<class> (namespace kept from the generating eth-vuln-formal-props package so names match its scripts/generate_theorem_map.py output). PROOF STATUS: this file carries NO proof-status field on purpose -- lean_status comes only from the exporter (`lake exe speca-export-ethvuln`, health JSON): a sorry-dependent theorem reads lean_status=unknown / sorry_free=false, a certified one reads proved / sorry_free=true. Nothing here may be read as a status claim. (As of the PR #24 review revision the placed statements are stated as named-predicate conclusions and their shallow implications are proved, but that fact is only ever reported by the exporter, never by this map.) Labels are ethereum-vuln-dataset labels; the ones that have a consensus-specs or execution-specs anchor in data/anchor_map*.json resolve to a spec_reference, the others (p2p, rpc, crypto, sync, txpool, engine-api, validator, build-ci, other, beacon-chain:sync-committee) have no pyspec/execution-specs anchor and spec_reference is honestly absent rather than pointed at a document that does not describe them. text is Japanese (dataset-derived values and identifiers stay English); x_entry_id is the dataset entry id and x_dataset_evidence the CSV title. Fields prefixed x_ are documentation and are not emitted. `shard` (= primary invariant class) groups properties for `emit-01e --out-dir`. Generated upstream by scripts/generate_theorem_map.py of the (private) eth-vuln-formal-props repository; placed here as SpecaExport.EthVuln.*. In addition to the label-level table anchoring, every entry carries an explicit per-entry x_spec_anchor (PR #24 review): either a consensus-specs/execution-specs section or symbol for protocol-semantics entries, or an explicit 'N/A -- <category>: <reason>' for out-of-spec surfaces (dependency libraries, devp2p networking, RPC/engine APIs, client internals, undisclosed advisories), which are tracked as implementation safety, never silently unanchored. Every entry also carries a deterministic audit_packet (tools/ethvuln-build-packets.py) with the three-way separation the PR #24 review asked for: guarantee (the exact Lean root conclusion), obligations (what the implementation must establish -- the named must-establish hypotheses, exact Lean types), preconditions (the full class-tagged hypothesis list, EthTotal-compatible rendering), and exact supporting-fact assertions (FACT-ROOT plus one FACT-OB* per obligation); packets carry no proof status -- that stays exporter-only.
